# Draft:War Thunder Mobile

War Thunder Mobile (formerly known as War Thunder Edge  ) is a game produced by Gajin Entertainment in August 15, 2023. It was produced as the mobile format of the game War Thunder.
Gameplay
The game consists of three modes, similar to the Main game, Ground, Air, and Naval. With veichles arranging from World War 2 icons to Modern veichles, As of July of 2025, only the Naval and Air modes have a Technology tree . Ground mode has a system of platoons, with a  group of 4 veichles (arranging from Heavy tanks, medium tanks, light tanks, IFV, SPAA, etc). Per battle, only 3 can be elected.
Trophies
A gacha system to unlock veichles for the 3 modes is updated per month with the updates, If a player missed the reward for former updates, another gacha to unlock former rewards runs for 7 days , before the end of the leaderboard
Updates
WTM has seasonal updates, per month, where on each update 4 platoons are added (16 veichles).
